description: This file defines a functional interface 'AuthenticationFailureAggregator' responsible for aggregating multiple failed authentication results into a single 'DittoRuntimeException'. It specifies a method to perform this aggregation, including detailed contract documentation about the behavior and exceptions.

classes.name: AuthenticationFailureAggregator
classes.description: A functional interface for aggregating multiple authentication failure reasons into a single exception.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Aggregates failure reasons from a list of AuthenticationResult objects into a single DittoRuntimeException, based on detailed rules about which failure reasons to consider and ignore.
